verdict.rationale: Capsule documents its own REST API on api.capsulecrm.com with bearer-token auth (personal tokens or OAuth), so an agent could plausibly pull CRM data. The product also stores opportunities and emails. However, the evidence never shows that the API exposes deals, emails or history, and there is no MCP server, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (all probes 404). Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for opportunities, emails and history, an official MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on evidence of an agent compiling a brief.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: API requests are made via HTTPS using the `api.capsulecrm.com` subdomain. Each request must be authenticated with a user's Bearer token.
Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
you can generate a token directly from your Capsule account to avoid the oAuth 2 flow.
